lines.text: The LORD gives Jeremiah a word about a drought, and the nobles' servants find no water in the cisterns.
The ground is cracked because no rain has fallen, and the doe deserts her fawn because there is no grass.
The people confess their sins and ask the LORD to act for His name, saying He is among them.
The LORD tells Jeremiah not to pray for the people and will finish them by sword, famine and fire.
Prophets promise peace, but the LORD did not send them, and people will be thrown into the streets of Samaria.
